Aipas M2 Pro Xterrain Ebike Overview
The Aipas M2 Pro Xterrain Ebike is a step-over model in the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup. It is built for riders who want strong motor support, stable handling, and a classic frame design for steep slopes, forest trails, rough terrain, gravel, mud, sand, and urban roads.
Its 26×4 puncture-resistant fat tires also connect the M2 Pro to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection by adding traction, balance, and comfort across loose, uneven, and mixed surfaces.
Exceptional Power and Performance
Equipped with a peak 1800W motor and 110Nm torque, the M2 Pro has the power profile expected from a model in the Aipas off-road lineup. It supports climbing, acceleration, and control on steep slopes, forest trails, and rough terrain.
Pair your ride with the Brushless Motor Controller and Hydraulic Brake System for greater precision and safety on demanding routes. If you want a higher-comfort version with more terrain-focused upgrades, consider the Aipas M2 Max Xterrain Ebike.
Long-Lasting Battery for Extended Rides
The 48V 17.5Ah lithium battery provides up to 85 miles per charge, giving the M2 Pro enough range for longer mixed-surface rides, daily routes, and weekend trips. Its removable design makes charging simple and flexible.
Comfortable Frame and Advanced Suspension
The alloy step-over frame gives the M2 Pro a more traditional ride position within the Aipas off-road lineup. It is built for riders who prefer a classic frame feel with stable handling and long-lasting durability.
The adjustable hydraulic front fork absorbs shocks and vibrations for smoother control across gravel, mud, sand, rough roads, and uneven paths. Upgrade your comfort with the Suspension Seatpost or the Extra Large Seat for long-distance rides.
Fat-Tire Stability and Reliable Safety
Featuring 26×4 puncture-resistant fat tires, the M2 Pro also connects to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection. This tire setup adds traction, balance, and comfort on gravel, mud, sand, snow, rough roads, and mixed surfaces.
Combined with dual 180mm disc brakes, the M2 Pro provides reliable stopping power for heavier tire setups, uneven surfaces, and changing weather conditions. Add a Bike Lock and Anti-Theft Alarm Taillight to protect your ride on the go.
Smart LCD Display and Multi-Mode Control
The integrated smart LCD display shows speed, distance, battery level, and riding mode in real time. Choose from Cruise, Sport, Assist, Pedal Assist, or Pure Electric Mode to match your riding style across city streets, rough roads, and mixed routes.
Enhance control with the Gear Shifter and Pedals designed for precise riding.
Ready to Ride with Easy Assembly
Arriving 90% pre-assembled, the M2 Pro is simple to set up and ready to ride in minutes. Expand your carrying capacity with a Cargo Companion or Water-Resistant Pannier Bags, and keep essentials close using the Phone Mount.
To compare more models in the same riding category, explore the Aipas off-road electric bikes collection.
